item.brief: Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant test suite, address failures, and commit the completed work on the item branch as requested by the operator. Acceptance criteria: behavior matches every specified requirement and error/boundary case in SPEC.md; documented API remains compatible; focused tests cover the specified cases; tests pass; commit is created.

pr.body: Implemented the documented retry_delay API in retry_budget.py, validating all arguments before exhaustion checks and rejecting bool, float, and int subclasses. Backoff doubles only until capped; Retry-After remains an uncapped minimum and the next attempt must start strictly before the budget. Added tests for invalid types and values, validation precedence, huge attempts, zero values, base greater than cap, attempt bounds, Retry-After, and budget equality. Checks: python -m unittest -v (11 passed), python -m py_compile retry_budget.py test_retry_budget.py (passed), git diff --check (passed). No repository contributor guidance files were present. Independent review passed with no findings.
